ترتضوا (form VIII)
# تَرْتَضُوا (tartaḍū) /tar.ta.dˤuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِرْتَضَى (irtaḍā)
# تُرْتَضَوْا (turtaḍaw) /tur.ta.dˤaw/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِرْتَضَى (irtaḍā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
